name: The Grand Tea Room
notes: Restaurant's own Wix site, server-rendered menu (Wix Menus widget) via plain curl. Sections: Afternoon Teas, A la Carte, Soups/Salads/Savories, Beverages — all priced per item. Below Beverages the page lists ~40 individual tea flavor names (Black Tea, Flavored Black Tea, White Tea, Green Tea, Oolong, Rooibos, Fruit & Herbal) with no price attached to any of them — these are the flavor choices covered under the single priced 'Fresh Pot of Tea' ($6.25) item, not separately priced dishes, so they were excluded per the no-price rule. Prices end on plausible dollar/quarter values with no markup pattern.

dishes.name: The Grand Tea
dishes.description: Soup and savory, assorted tea sandwiches and savory, fresh fruit, scone with cream, lemon curd and preserves, petite desserts, and a freshly steeped tea of your choice. Two hour tea time.

dishes.name: The Garden Tea
dishes.description: Assorted tea sandwiches and savory, fresh fruit, scone with cream, lemon curd and preserves, petite desserts, and freshly steeped tea of your choice. Two hour tea time.

dishes.name: The Children's Tea
dishes.description: Ages 10 and under. Selection of two tea sandwiches and savory, fresh fruit, scone with cream, lemon curd and preserves, selection of two petite desserts, and freshly steeped tea of your choice or milk. Two hour tea time.

dishes.name: The Light Lunch Tea
dishes.description: Assorted tea sandwiches, small garden salad, fresh fruit, scone with cream, lemon curd and preserves, and freshly steeped tea of your choice.

dishes.name: The Cream Tea
dishes.description: Fresh fruit, scone with cream, lemon curd and preserves, and freshly steeped tea of your choice.

dishes.name: Petite Desserts
dishes.description: Delicate assortment of tea desserts. Ask your server about the selection of the day.

dishes.name: Fresh Fruit Bowl
dishes.description: A selection of delicious locally grown fruit.

dishes.name: Fresh Scone
dishes.description: Freshly baked scone served with fruit preserves, lemon curd, and cream. Ask your server about the flavors of the day.

dishes.name: Tea Sandwiches
dishes.description: Selection of three assorted tea sandwiches.

dishes.name: Tea Sandwiches and Savory
dishes.description: Three assorted sandwiches with savory. Ask your server about the savory flavor of the day.

dishes.name: Seasonal Salad
dishes.description: Fresh salad greens, fresh berries, grapes, sliced pear, cranberries, glazed walnuts, feta cheese and served with raspberry vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Garden Salad
dishes.description: Fresh salad greens, grape tomatoes, zucchini, cucumber, carrots, cranberries and glazed walnuts served with ranch or raspberry vinaigrette dressing.

dishes.name: Side Garden Salad
dishes.description: Fresh salad greens, grape tomatoes, zucchini, cucumber, carrots, served with ranch or raspberry vinaigrette dressing.

dishes.name: Soup of the Day
dishes.description: Cup of soup and a baguette with parmesan cheese.

dishes.name: Fresh Pot of Tea
dishes.description: Freshly steeped pot of tea with your choice of over 40 flavors. Bottomless! Per person.
